evidence.supports: L1 Rh5/Rh6 visual input topology and early processing of ambient and temporal light signals
L1 olfactory receptor-to-antennal-lobe wiring and gain-control topology
L1 thermotaxis in a measured 0.5 degC per cm linear gradient and temporal thermal sampling
L2 phototaxis temporal comparisons and direction-sensitive Bolwig-organ context only
L2 odor navigation based on temporal concentration changes rather than direct bilateral gradient measurement

limitations: The validation light, temperature, and odor fields are analytic fixtures rather than reconstructed natural L1 habitats.
The four head surface samples are virtual spatial probes and are not claimed as measured Bolwig-organ, dorsal-organ, or olfactory receptor coordinates.
All transduction scales, spatial and temporal gains, adaptation constants, modality weights, and the common baseline are MODEL_FITTED.
L2 behavioral findings provide response-structure priors only; their absolute stimulus-response values are not copied as L1 constants.
Temperature and odor use temporal contrast only; the model does not invent direct bilateral gradient sensing for those modalities.

This model does not yet reproduce modality-specific receptor populations, the complete sensory-to-descending connectome, stochastic run-turn transitions, or validated natural phototaxis, thermotaxis, or chemotaxis.
Environment code supplies local scalar samples and receptor currents only; it does not choose a movement, target, or orientation.
